name: Explicit Radiance Field (ERF) Reconstruction
definition: A direct, uniform 3D reconstruction method from registered multi-view images that uses an explicit SVO representation with dynamic voxel allocations, avoiding implicit network-based model parts and external initialization constraints.
summary: Explicit Radiance Field Reconstruction is a direct 3D method using Sparse Voxel Octrees and opacity fields to avoid implicit neural networks and blurry free-space transitions.
